title: Design: Green success toast looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active and is not the default for new customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p1-10-saved.png, ct-p2-05-moved.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 30 row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Click "Make Default".
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation "Make Net 30 the default?" opens.

Step 3:

  • A green toast opens at the bottom right of the page (as in ct-p1-10-saved.png): a white check-circle icon at the left, the first line "Net 30 is now the default" in bold, the line "New customers start on Net 30." below it, and a "Close" text button at the right.

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R6: “On "Make Default", the term becomes the default, the "Default" tag moves to its row, and a success toast shows "{name} is now the default" with the line "New customers start on {name}." No customer, vendor or invoice changes.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Make Default confirmed | "{name} is now the default" / "New customers start on {name}." | Success toast with a Close action”
